_about: The works: one real goal at a time outside the knee, in 2-5 tasks (clean it, park it, list it). `darrow.py project open|done|show|drop`; `today` names the next task. Each task reported pays one piece of the tale bound to the project (`saga.py tale bind`, then `saga.py brief --tale`), the last piece its keepsake; a finished project counts in the sheet's WORKS and brings one Inspiration. Titles and tasks are real-world words: they never reach the Chronicle or the site, only the counts do. Dates are the days the tasks were reported. A project set aside by his call keeps `deferred {date, from_due, why, resumes}`: until `resumes` (a Sunday) `today` names it as resting, not as the day's next task.
